policy.indexable_core: Public service, conversion, media, and hub pages are indexable and included in sitemap.xml.
policy.indexable_articles: Approved Markdown articles are indexable and included in sitemap.xml.
policy.legal_noindex: Human-readable legal documents remain noindex,follow and are linked from the footer.
policy.technical_noindex: Form-processing endpoints and 404.html remain noindex,follow and are excluded from the sitemap.
